unit.why: The Gostynin rebbe tells the narrator a tale, passed down through R. Shimon Sofer of Krakow from his father the Hatam Sofer, about where R. Mordechai Banet was buried. The core narrative concerns non-Hasidic rabbinic figures, inside a Hasidic transmission frame.

stories.start_quote: מעשה נאה ונפלאה, בשנת תרצ״ט ישבתי
stories.summary_en: R. Mordechai Banet dies in a tiny village, and Nikolsburg and the villagers dispute his burial all the way to the royal court. The authorities refer the case to the Hatam Sofer. Banet appears to him in a dream and explains that Heaven decreed his burial there, beside a bride he had released from an engagement, as punishment for that release, even though it was lawful.

tags.why: The story praises and concerns the Hatam Sofer and R. Mordechai Banet, both non-Hasidic sages.

quotes: וסיפר לי ע"ז מעשה נפלאה אשר סיפר לו
tags.why: The Gostynin rebbe tells the tale, which reached him through a chain of tellers.

quotes: הנפטר בא אצלו בחלום ודיבר אליו בזה"ל
tags.why: The dead rabbi reveals the reason for his burial place in a dream.

quotes: הנפטר בא אצלו בחלום ודיבר אליו
tags.why: A dead man's soul speaks to the Hatam Sofer.
The rabbi's death sets off the plot.

quotes: לקדש בית קברותם בגויתבנוית קדוש זה
tags.why: The tzaddik's grave is treated as a sanctifying holy site that both sides want.

quotes: והיה ריב גדול בין הצדדים עד שנגשו
tags.why: Two communities dispute where to bury him.

quotes: עד שהגיע אל בית המלך והיושבים ראשונה
tags.why: The case goes up to the royal government, which refers it to the Hatam Sofer.

quotes: אתה כבר העלית ע״פ הלכה שאנשי
tags.why: Both the burial ruling and the release from the engagement are matters of halakhah.

quotes: נגזר עלי מן השמים לעונש על שנתתי
tags.why: Heaven punishes the rabbi with his burial place.

quotes: בעסק שידוך אשר לקחני אבי הכלה
tags.why: Releases from engagements (shidduchim) are the story's subject.

quotes: שלא להגיס לבו בעניני שידוכים למהר
tags.why: The story warns against hastily granting releases from engagements.
The Hatam Sofer wakes from the dream in trembling.

quotes: שאותה הכלה שנתתי עליה פטורים היא שוכבת
tags.why: The hidden reason for his death in the village is revealed afterwards.

quotes: שאותה הכלה שנתתי עליה פטורים היא שוכבת
tags.why: The bride is mentioned but does not act.

quotes: וכריך כל רב להיות שמור וזהיר מזה
